slot_change_request: KVCTRL core_s7 child of the c1 wires-parent qkd_ctrl_pc_host_static (247.512 x 378 controller slot). Sched: W = controller command / strap / drain face, E = port + ECC seams, S = PHY po, N = cdc / obs seams + clock.

job.purpose: sched_s8 (KV-SCHED8 2026-10-17, rtl_change): CLOSED sched_s7b (qkd_ctrl_pc_sched_s7b-s7b-bfe218fc8, main f863de3b4; TT +17.63 / FF +18.87 after a 0.31% LVT swap) FAILS the native pin audit (/home/ubuntu/artifacts/qkvelem2-1017/native_audit_sched_obs_row.json): launch 308.9 po[294] on 309 pins (po 287, ko 22), capture 306.2 p_fault on 175 pins (c_d 163), R 184.3, spread 20.1, 0 comb. Classified on the routed s7b view: po / ko ARE flop-driven, but the flop sits at the far face -- po = p_wd (E) -> S and ko = ki (N) -> S are one-register feed-throughs (po[294] DFFASRHQNx1 QN 134 ps into 21.5 fF + 26 ps wire, po[100] 103 ps wire) -- behind a 3-cell outhold chain (~75 ps on every output); c_d[255:0] -> p_w_d (E) is a pure N -> E wire to one register behind an inhold pad (76+28 ps, +90..112 ps wire+repeater); the single-pin captures (c_v, p_kv_v, p_em_v, obs/native_commit_valid, f_ecdc, p_fault, e_fault, fi, native_observer_fault) feed the idle_hbm veto / fo OR trees (3-5 gates) before a flop. Fix (RTL parameter PINREG=1, kit recipe 4 hold_budget die: no pin hold pads): feed-throughs get a register at each face (s7b register = input pin flop, new output pin register), fo / idle_hbm / p_w_v are computed one edge later from pin flops of their raw inputs (D-form). Exact: po, p_w_v, p_w_d, physical_context, physical_col_sr, expected_sr, idle_hbm, fo, ko = s7b outputs one hclk later, every other output same-cycle (tb_sched_pinreg_equiv vs the committed s7b reference; mutant OT_SCHED_PINREG_MUT fails). Schedule cost: PHY command/write-data bus +1 hclk (KV read/write +1; JEDEC spacings and the port wd/column alignment preserved; obs / cdc static-completion observations move with it), static write data +1 (WQ FIFO, >= 5-edge column lead), kc chain +1 hclk per station, fault chain +1 per station, idle_hbm +1; u_ctl command, credit, ECC lookahead, co_c, e_sec / e_row: 0 cycles. Same outline, pins and faces. | KVCTRL core_s7 (lead Q-KV decision 2026-10-17): core_s6w CLOSED TT +4.34 / FF +10.33 but native audit FAIL (R 265.4: one hclk root of 13.8k sinks over 116.6 x 216 um measured ~275 ps TT insertion; launch 420.6 on 216 pins, capture 401.5 on 175 pins incl. ~155 ps of hold-ECO IO padding). The core is split into three hardened children with short roots (target R <= 170), every pin flop-first: qkd_ctrl_pc_sched (u_ctl, tag queue, raw check, arbiter, W/E pin flops, KV drain / idle_hbm), qkd_ctrl_pc_cdc_child (u_ecdc both clocks + core-clock intake / intake check / er / core drain / idle_core / static completion crossing, with pin registers on the u_ctl credit and the embedding return and output registers on the down FIFO), qkd_ctrl_pc_obs_child (native write observer behind input pin registers + native commit pin registers). Priced vs core_s6: static embed command +1 hclk, embedding return +1 hclk, u_ctl credit +1 hclk, native commit observation +1 hclk; KV read/write traffic 0 edges. Sched: W = controller command / strap / drain face, E = port + ECC seams, S = PHY po, N = cdc / obs seams + clock. s7b: sched_s7 gate 9,098 sinks TT boundary mean 198.6 / max 203.7 with the clock pin at the NW corner (util already 51%): pll_hbm centred on the N face.

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every seam/pin explicitly (sched_s8 PINREG=1: every input that feeds logic or a cross-tile wire lands in a pin flop -- c_v / c_d[286] / kv_v / em_v / obs / native commit valid / fault pins; the W/E capture pins keep their s7b pin flops; every output is driven by its own register at its pin: po, p_w_*, physical_*, expected_sr, idle_hbm, fo, ko re-registered one hclk later). p_kv_v keeps only its 0-cycle select of the e_sec / e_row lookahead (the ECC child captures the port beat and e_sec on the same edge); the tag pointer / tag check use its pin flop; ki lands only in the tap's o_v / o_d pin flops (tap command decoded after them, 0 cycles). No extra wrapper edges.
